items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I heard Chick Webb's band... I enjoyed listening to it.

ctx.x: going to show this girl that I really knew what was happening. She didn't know that I had never been inside the theatre myself. But I took her to the Howard Theatre, and we sat in the balcony. All of a sudden, after the picture... When we went in, the picture was on. Then after the picture, the lights came on.

There's a fellow, Shep Allen, that just passed away recently, who was a legend with the Howard Theatre here in Washington, or was a legend with the theatre. He made this announcement that "Next week's coming revue..." The next band the following week was going to be Chick Webb, and... He used to use the expression "Chick Webb's band with a gala revue." He would say, "And now, ladies and gentlemen, for your listening pleasure, Fletcher Henderson." And the band would start to play behind the curtain, and the…
